heroTitle: Structure AI adoption from your company's processes and goals
lead: Process mapping, use case prioritization, and design of the AI architecture for operations. From strategy to implementation, considering governance and business objectives.
contextTitle: Where can AI make sense in your operation?
context: Identifying opportunities requires understanding processes and linking them to business objectives. Without that view, it is hard to prioritize use cases and think about AI architecture with governance in mind. Consulting addresses this path; format, scope, and terms are to be confirmed.
solutionTitle: From process analysis to AI architecture design
solutionText: Consulting covers process mapping, use case prioritization, and design of the AI architecture for operations. The approach considers governance and business objectives and may span strategy through implementation. Work detail and what will be contracted must be defined in the proposal; no official method or package is specified in the briefing.
audiences: Companies that want to structure artificial intelligence adoption.
Leaders who need to connect AI initiatives to business objectives.
Organizations seeking to evaluate processes and prioritize use cases with governance in mind.

goals.title: Map processes
goals.text: Understand operation processes as a starting point to evaluate AI opportunities.

goals.title: Prioritize use cases
goals.text: Organize opportunities according to business objectives; priorities and criteria depend on company context.

goals.title: Design architecture
goals.text: Consider an AI architecture for operations, taking governance and objectives into account, without assuming specific technologies.
